# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 24 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 24 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_024_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 4, Chapter 3

**1** I asked her about the four colors on the beast's head. She replied, "You are eager about these things again." "Yes, my lady — please tell me what they mean." **2** "The black represents this present world in which you live. **3** The fiery and blood-red means that this world must be destroyed by blood and fire. **4** The golden part represents you and all who flee from this world. For just as gold is refined by fire and made useful, so you who live in this world are being refined. Those who remain and pass through the flames will be purified by them. Just as gold sheds its dross, so you will shed all sorrow and anguish, and you will be purified and fit for the building of the tower. **5** The white part represents the coming age, in which the chosen of God will dwell. For those chosen by God will be spotless and pure, and the life of the age to come will be radiant. **6** Therefore never stop speaking these things into the ears of the saints. You also have the foreshadowing of the great tribulation to come — but if you are willing, it will amount to nothing. Remember everything that has been written before." **7** When she had said these things she departed, and I could not see in which direction she went, for there was a sound; and I turned around in fear, thinking the beast was coming.

---

*LOGOS note: The fourfold color scheme maps the entire eschatological drama: present age → destruction → purification → age to come. The Shepherd's eschatology is cosmological but deeply personal — "you are being refined."*
